responsibility: Implements trait-selection support for opaque types (`impl Trait` and type-alias `impl Trait`) by translating an instantiated hidden type back into the opaque type’s defining form under the opaque type’s own generic parameters, validating that only allowed generic arguments and regions appear, checking that the inferred hidden type is well formed and satisfies the opaque type’s declared bounds, and computing auxiliary lifetime requirements such as required region bounds from elaborated predicates.
